text:
The meal on the plate looks like sliced avocado (about half to three-quarters of one), a poached or egg-white-heavy egg, and some cooked mushrooms. The mug holds tea, which adds essentially no calories.

Estimated served energy:
- Avocado, about 100 g: 160 kcal, 2 g protein, 9 g carbs, 15 g fat
- Egg, 1 large: 75 kcal, 6 g protein, 0.5 g carbs, 5 g fat
- Mushrooms, about 40 g cooked: 15 kcal, 2 g protein, 2 g carbs, 0.2 g fat
- Tea: about 2 kcal

That gives about 252 kcal served.

The photo shows the meal before eating, so I can't see what will be left over. I assumed some of it would be left, such as the mushroom stems or part of the egg white, and set leftover at about 10 kcal. That leaves about 242 kcal eaten.

Estimated intake, scaled slightly for the leftovers: about 9.5 g protein, 11 g carbs and 19 g fat.
